csv_agency: City of Columbus Department of Finance & Manage.
csv_scope_of_work: The scope of the work shall include design, engineering, and construction contract administration services. The project's scope would include designing improvements for community buildings that Grants Management chooses through its competitive CDBG grant application process. The selected properties will be finalized following this RFP, but will include approximately 6-8 separate non-profit facilities. Roof renovations, paving, fencing, exterior accessibility improvements, fire suppression/ life safety systems, elevator systems, interior kitchen, laundry, bathroom, and other space remodeling, including some plumbing, drywall, electrical, and HVAC adjustments, are all anticipated to be included in the scope.

title: AE for CDBG Facilities Renovation 2026-27
short_description: Design services for renovations at multiple nonprofit community buildings in Columbus, Ohio.
project_scope: Design and construction contract administration for approximately 6-8 separate nonprofit community facilities selected through the City's competitive CDBG grant process. Anticipated renovation measures include roof renovations, paving, fencing, exterior accessibility improvements, fire suppression and life safety systems, elevator systems, interior remodeling of kitchens, laundries, bathrooms, and other spaces, plus associated plumbing, drywall, electrical, and HVAC adjustments.
services: Architecture, engineering, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, and construction contract administration.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily renovation of small community buildings with conventional building upgrades.
- No indication of large spans, special structures, bridges, stadiums, or architecturally demanding structural systems.
- Scope includes broad AE services, but structural engineering is not specifically emphasized.
- Strong focus on building systems and refurbishment items such as HVAC, plumbing, accessibility, and interiors, which are less aligned with sbp's core profile.
- Multiple facilities may offer some entry potential, but overall strategic fit is low.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the tender text. Available scope information: approximately 6-8 nonprofit facilities with roof, paving, fencing, accessibility, fire suppression, elevator, kitchen, laundry, bathroom, and general interior remodeling works. This suggests a multi-site renovation program, but no reliable USD estimate can be derived from the provided text alone.
fee_explanation: No design fee or engineering fee is stated in the tender text.
contracting_authority: City of Columbus, Department of Finance & Management, Columbus, Ohio, USA. Email: DFMRFP@columbus.gov. Phone: 614-645-5184. Website: https://columbus.bonfirehub.com/opportunities/233774
notes: Project number 4292026; contract number RFP-US.233774. Questions deadline: 2026-05-15 01:00 PM EDT. Contract duration: 12 months. Two or more contractors will be selected. Final properties will be determined after this RFP through the CDBG grant application process.
